source: flash_attn_ext_f16_iter, fattn-mma-f16.cuh lines 583-1072 (TURING_MMA_AVAILABLE branches) + ggml_cuda_mma primitives of mma.cuh
claim: structural port only; no compile/GPU/numeric acceptance claimed; parent reviews, emits and compares against native on GPU

fixed_config.gpu_target: CUDA Ada (SM89), TURING_MMA_AVAILABLE tile set, mma.m16n8k16.row.col
fixed_config.np: 2 when ncols1==4, 1 when ncols1==8 (runtime argument, caller must keep consistent with ncols1)

tiles.T_C_KQ: tile<16,16,float>, wide column-major: physical I=Q column j, physical J=KV row i
tiles.Q_B: 16 tiles x 4 u32 = 256 B per thread, read-only input state
tiles.VKQ_C: 16 tiles x 4 u32 = 256 B per thread, mutated f16 accumulator state
tiles.KQ_C: 32/(np*16) local fixed-array tiles per warp (1 for np=2, 2 for np=1), 8 f32/thread each, fresh zero per call
tiles.B_probs: 32/(np*16) local tiles, 4 u32/thread each, get_half2(KQ_C) without transpose

entry.signature: fn iterate(k_h2:u64, v_h2:u64, mask_h:u64, stride_k:i64, stride_v:i64, stride_mask:i64, slope:f32, jt:i32, kb0:i32, n_queries:i64, ncols1:i32, qregs:u64, vkqregs:u64, kmax:u64, rowsums:u64, smem:u64, tx:i32, ty:i32, np:i32, last:bool)

params.k_h2: raw u64 byte address of global K rows as half2 (native K_h2)
params.v_h2: raw u64 byte address of global V rows as half2 (native V_h2)
params.mask_h: raw u64 byte address of global mask rows as half (native mask_h); only dereferenced by the fg175l loader
params.stride_k: K row stride in half2 elements (native stride_K)
params.stride_v: V row stride in half2 elements (native stride_V)
params.stride_mask: mask row stride in half elements (native stride_mask)
params.slope: native slope; multiplied into the mask add via fmaf (scale is NOT applied here: native pre-scales Q at tile_Q load)
params.jt: Q tile index along ncols1; query0=jt*ncols1 computed in Goose
params.kb0: KV batch index; kv_row0=kb0*32 computed in Goose
params.n_queries: ne01 extent used by the loader fastmodulo wrap of mask rows
params.ncols1: 4 or 8, forwarded to the fg175l mask loader
params.qregs: u64 byte address of this thread's Q_B POD state
params.vkqregs: u64 byte address of this thread's VKQ_C POD state
params.kmax: u64 byte address of this thread's KQ_max[2] f32
params.rowsums: u64 byte address of this thread's KQ_rowsum[2] f32
params.smem: u64 byte address (generic/shared space) of the tile area below
params.np: parallel warps per Q column: 2 (ncols1=4) or 1 (ncols1=8)
params.last: true on the final kb0 iteration; suppresses only the next K+mask preload

entry.pointer_convention: all u64 values are raw byte addresses; every offset, permutation and swizzle is computed in Goose and passed absolute
entry.no_heap: no allocation, no stack VM, no recursion; locals are fixed-size arrays/scalars/struct records only

qregs_256B_readonly.layout: Q_B[16] of tile<16,8,half2>; tile q element l at byte q*16+l*4
qregs_256B_readonly.fragment: x[l] = Q_half2[j0 + (l%2)*8 + tx/4][8q + (l/2)*4 + tx%4] with j0=(ty/np)*16; must be produced by native load_ldmatrix (non-trans ldmatrix.x4) from tile_Q rows j0..j0+15, half2 cols 8q..8q+7, row stride 132 half2 (DKQ/2+4), values pre-scaled by scale and zero-filled for OOB Q rows exactly as fattn-mma-f16.cuh L1300-1327
qregs_256B_readonly.operand_role: A operand of the KQ mma (M=Q column j, K=16 halves)

vkqregs_256B_mutated.layout: VKQ_C[16] of tile<16,8,half2>; tile v element l at byte v*16+l*4
vkqregs_256B_mutated.fragment: get_i(l)=(l%2)*8+tx/4 -> Q column (ty/np)*16+..., get_j(l)=(l/2)*4+tx%4 -> D half2 col 8v+...; covers Q cols (ty/np)*16..+15 x D [16v,16v+16)
vkqregs_256B_mutated.init: parent must zero before the first iterate call
vkqregs_256B_mutated.updates: f16x2 rescale by KQ_max_scale then mma.f16 accumulation each call

register_state.kmax_8B_mutated: KQ_max[2] f32 at bytes 0/4; parent initializes both to -FLT_MAX/2 (native L1272); each call replaces them with KQ_max_new
register_state.rowsums_8B_mutated: KQ_rowsum[2] f32 at bytes 0/4; parent initializes to 0; each call applies scale*old+rowsum_add via fmaf
register_state.thread_private: all four are strictly per-thread PODs; no cross-thread access, no heap

shared_layout.tile_K: smem+0, 8192 B: 32 rows x 128 half2, row stride 512 B, swizzle off^((row%8)<<2) in half2 units (swizzle<128,half2>)
shared_layout.tile_V: smem+8192, 8192 B: same geometry and swizzle as tile_K
shared_layout.tile_mask: smem+16384, ncols1*80 B: ncols1 rows x 20 half2 (64 B data + 16 B pad per row; pad unwritten and unread)
shared_layout.stages: single-buffered tiles; cross-iteration WAR safety comes from the barrier at iterate entry (next K/mask) and the barrier before the V issue (previous VKQ reads)

primitives.naming: fg176i_* adapters must exist in the parent bridge; each is ONE ISA instruction plus register moves except where noted
primitives.ldu_a_u64_u32: generic 32-bit load at absolute byte address (ld.global.b32 or ld.local.b32 depending on where the POD state lives)
primitives.ldm4_a_u64_U4: ldmatrix.sync.aligned.m8n8.x4.b16 on the shared address; U4 = tile registers x[0..3] in hardware order
primitives.ldm4t_a_u64_U4: ldmatrix.sync.aligned.m8n8.x4.trans.b16; U4 = hardware registers h0..h3 (Goose remaps to tile order 0,2,1,3)
primitives.hhi_w_u32_f32: cvt.f32.f16 of the high half (shift/register move + cvt; fg174m whi precedent)
primitives.h2_a_f32_b_f32_u32: make_half2: two cvt.rn.f16.f32 + pack move (multi-instruction by nature, matches native make_half2)
primitives.expf_x_f32_f32: device expf exactly as native codegen (fg174m expf precedent; not a single instruction, matches native numerics)

imported_loaders.fg175l_load_kv: Goose loader adapter (loaders-device.goose) issuing cp.async.cg 16 B for K/V tiles; called as (src, dst_shared, stride_kv_h2:i64, kv_row0:i64, tx, ty)
imported_loaders.fg175l_load_mask: called as (src, dst_shared, stride_mask_half:i64, kv_row0:i64, query0:i64, n_queries:i64, ncols1:i32, tx, ty)
imported_loaders.binding: parent binds these extern names to the fg175l Goose loaders (actual Goose, no native algorithm callback); joint compile must dedupe definitions
imported_loaders.usage: entry: V tile of kb0; tail when !last: mask then K tile of kb0+1

numerics.KQ_max_offset: FATTN_KQ_MAX_OFFSET = 3.0*0.6931 added to every score before the running max
numerics.softmax: KQ_C = expf(KQ_C - KQ_max_new); divisor accumulated in KQ_rowsum, applied by the parent epilogue
numerics.shfl_reduce: KQ_max_new reduces over the 4 threads sharing a KQ column via shfl_xor offsets 2 then 1 (TURING, cols_per_warp=16)
numerics.ftz: KQ_max_scale bits multiplied by (KQ_max_diff >= SOFTMAX_FTZ_THRESHOLD == -20.0); implemented as the native u32 bit-multiply via as! casts
numerics.fused_steps: mask add slope*mask+KQ and rowsum scale*rowsum+rowsum_add use the fmaf primitive (native -fmad=true contraction)
numerics.half_conversions: cvt.rn.f16.f32 for make_half2/get_half2, cvt.f32.f16 for __half2float, mul.rn.f16x2 for the VKQ scale
numerics.mma_accum: KQ in f32 (two m16n8k16.f32.f16.f16.f32 per tile-mma, B registers 0,2 then 1,3); VKQ in packed f16 (two m16n8k16.f16.f16.f16.f16 per tile-mma, same B order, no f32 substitute)

mma_operand_map.KQ: native wide-CUDA swap: mma(KQ_C, Q_B, K_A); Q_B is A (M=j, K=16 halves), K_A is B (tile rows = n = KV row i, tile cols = k/2); K_A from ldmatrix.x4 at tile_K half2 offset (t*np*16+(ty%np)*16)*128 + q*8, per-lane row tx%16, col (tx/16)*4, swizzled (row%8)<<2
mma_operand_map.KQ_f32_pair: first mma consumes K_A registers x0,x2 into C elements 0..3 (KV rows 0..7), second consumes x1,x3 into elements 4..7 (KV rows 8..15)
mma_operand_map.VKQ: native wide-CUDA swap: mma(VKQ_C, B_probs, A_V); A_V from ldmatrix.x4.trans at tile_V half2 offset 2*k0*128 + v*8 (k0=k00*np*8+(ty%np)*8), hardware registers remapped 0,2,1,3; first mma consumes (x0,x2) -> D.x[0..1], second (x1,x3) -> D.x[2..3]
mma_operand_map.probs: B_probs.x[c] = half2(KQ_C.x[2c], KQ_C.x[2c+1]); register order already compatible with the A operand on Turing

sequencing.per_iter: 1) cp.async.wait_all + __syncthreads (K+mask of kb0 ready) 2) issue cp.async V tile of kb0 3) KQ mma over k in [0,128) 4) slope mask add 5) running max + shfl_xor 2/1 6) expf + rowsum_add 7) KQ_max/rowsum rescale (FTZ, fmaf) 8) VKQ f16 rescale 9) build B_probs 10) wait_all + __syncthreads (V tile ready) 11) if !last: issue mask+K of kb0+1 12) VKQ mma over all 16 v-tiles
sequencing.last_iter: step 11 skipped; both waits/barriers still execute (native L985-987 are unconditional)
sequencing.parent_prologue: before the first iterate: fg175l load_mask + load_tile_K for kb0_start (native L1335-1347), Q_B preload into qregs, VKQ_C zero, KQ_max=-FLT_MAX/2, KQ_rowsum=0
sequencing.parent_epilogue: after the last iterate: one __syncthreads (native L1394, nwarps*cols_per_warp=64>32), rowsum shfl_xor reduction (offsets 2 then 1), normalize by KQ_rowsum, dstk write/fixup, combine

out_of_scope: host/scheduler/launch configuration, Q global->tile_Q load and scaling, Q_B preload, VKQ init
rowsum cross-warp reduction, output normalization, dstk/dstk_fixup, attention sinks
use_logit_softcap, V_is_K_view, use_sparse, oob_check, nstages<=1, Volta/AMD paths
